command: cd /workspace/inventory && cat tests/test_stock.py tests/conftest.py && cat README.md TODO.md pyproject.toml
cd /workspace/inventory && for f in .gnomon/system.md .gnomon/policy.toml .gnomon/skills/writing-tests.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace/inventory && ls -la var/ && cat src/inventory/report.py src/inventory/__init__.py src/inventory/pricing.py && cat CHANGELOG.md && git log --oneline -8 && git status --short

cd /workspace/inventory && file var/local.db 2>/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect("var/local.db")
print(c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'").fetchall())
PY
cat .gitignore

cd /workspace/inventory && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "--- mutation check: does the suite bite? ---" && cp src/inventory/stock.py /tmp/stock.orig && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/inventory/stock.py")
t = p.read_text()
p.write_text(t.replace("if qty < threshold", "if qty <= threshold"))
PY
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -4; cp /tmp/stock.orig src/inventory/stock.py
echo "--- restored, inverted sort check ---"
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/inventory/stock.py")
p.write_text(p.read_text().replace("return sorted(sku for", "return sorted((sku for").replace("if qty < threshold)", "if qty < threshold), reverse=True)"))
PY
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -4; cp /tmp/stock.orig src/inventory/stock.py
echo "--- final ---" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && git diff --stat

cd /workspace/inventory && git diff && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from inventory import Stock
s=Stock(); s.add('widget',5); s.add('gadget',2); s.add('gizmo',9)
print(s.low_stock(6), s.low_stock(0), s.low_stock(100))"
